reviews.title: Falsely advertising
reviews.text: Falsely advertising on youtube. Bad practices, takes money then dont let you find subscriptions
reviews.reply:
Hi there,

Thank you for sharing your feedback.

We’re sorry that you were left with this impression of Nebula and understand how upsetting this situation must feel. 

Please be assured that our platform is fully secure, and no charges can be made without a user’s explicit consent. 
All purchase details are always shown before confirmation, and subscriptions can be managed or canceled anytime.

We’d like to review your case carefully and assist you personally. 

Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com, and our team will look into this matter and help.

Warm regards,
Nebula Team 🔮
